title: Chittagong Hill Tracts Peace Accord
subtitle: A formal peace agreement ended two decades of insurgency but left contested implementation questions.
summary: On 2 December 1997, the Government of Bangladesh and PCJSS signed the Chittagong Hill Tracts Peace Accord. The accord ended large-scale insurgency under the Shanti Bahini framework, introduced institutional commitments on autonomy and land issues, and began a long implementation process.
heroTagline: A formal peace agreement ended two decades of insurgency but left contested implementation questions.
whyItMatters: The accord remains crucial for understanding citizenship, indigeneity, land rights, and center-periphery state relations in Bangladesh.

claimCitations.claim: On 2 December 1997, the Government of Bangladesh and PCJSS signed the Chittagong Hill Tracts Peace Accord. The accord ended large-scale insurgency under the Shanti Bahini framework, introduced institutional commitments on autonomy and land issues, and began a long implementation process.
The accord remains crucial for understanding citizenship, indigeneity, land rights, and center-periphery state relations in Bangladesh.
